name: Arkansas
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. Arkansas's extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward): Oklahoma in the west, Louisiana in the south, Missouri in the north, the Mississippi in the east. Landlocked, so there is no water to trim. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-ar.
